recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-13182 unless Pharmacy later reopens the separate naming concern represented by FHIR-14565.
issue_request: FHIR-13182 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed. It requested changing the element from positiveInt so zero refills can be represented, with the accepted resolution to use unsignedInt and add explicit guidance.
initial_application: Git commit 31cfc6d05232af02a82de9806bf972d89ef41064 applied tracker 13182 by changing the MedicationRequest source spreadsheet datatype to unsignedInt, adding a sentence that zero refills may be explicitly stated after the initial dispense, and updating medicationrequest0301.xml to show value 0.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition source has type unsignedInt and the zero-refill guidance, medicationrequest0301.xml still contains the zero-value example, and the CQL model definition also lists the element as FHIR.unsignedInt. FHIR-13321 was closed as a duplicate of approved FHIR-13182, and FHIR-14565 later declined a rename of the same element.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already implements the requested datatype, guidance, and example, and source searches found no conflicting positiveInt definition for the current element.

related_jiras.note: Same unsignedInt request for numberOfRepeatsAllowed, explicitly resolved as a duplicate of approved FHIR-13182.
Later Pharmacy no-change decision declined renaming numberOfRepeatsAllowed to numberOfRepeatDispensesAllowed, so it does not alter this seed's datatype/guidance reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed to allow zero repeats by changing to unsignedInt and adding explicit guidance.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final Jira decision and defines the target source behavior for the reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Eric Haas raised that positiveInt prevented zero refills, and Lloyd McKenzie agreed zero refills must be representable with explicit usage notes.
evidence_items.learned: The community thread confirms the rationale for the Jira resolution and does not broaden the required change beyond datatype/guidance.

evidence_items.summary: Tracker 13182 commit changed numberOfRepeatsAllowed to unsignedInt, added zero-refill guidance, and changed medicationrequest0301.xml to value 0.
evidence_items.learned: The accepted change was historically applied to source rather than only recorded in Jira.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest is active in fhir.ini, and the current element definition has type unsignedInt plus the sentence allowing explicit zero refills after the initial dispense.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current build-scope source already satisfies the seed request.
